The server exposes **302 tools**. *Kind* says whether a tool only reads, writes, or can
delete; write tools that change many records or money default to a dry run and need an explicit confirmation.
The full input schema of each tool is in [`src/handlers/tool.definitions.ts`](https://github.com/GDSTechnology/psarelay/blob/main/src/handlers/tool.definitions.ts).

## Vendor Billing

|---|---|---|

| `autotask_vendor_import_invoice` | writes | Import a vendor billing file into the reconciliation store (Postgres only — nothing in Autotask changes). |
| `autotask_vendor_get_lines` | read-only | Imported vendor invoice lines with filters, plus totals by charge class, cadence and customer. |
| `autotask_reconcile_resolve_mapping` | writes | Review and decide the durable identity mappings reconciliation runs on (stored in the MCP's Postgres; nothing in Autotask changes). |
| `autotask_vendor_prices` | writes | The vendor price reference reconciliation and catalog plans price from: partner cost and the vendor’s suggested price per SKU and term (MM / AM / monthly per month; AA / annual per year), each with its source and date. |

| `autotask_vendor_pricing_policy` | writes | How "Price Should Be" is set (requirements §5). |
| `autotask_reconcile_export_workbook` | read-only | The reconciliation workbook (.xlsx, base64 in contentBase64) for a run (default the latest): Executive Summary, Exceptions, All Vendor Lines, Customer Contracts, Unmatched / Internal / NFR, Approved Changes, Execution Audit, Pricing Policy. |

| `autotask_contract_plan_move_lines` | read-only | Build (nothing is written) a frozen plan that MOVES contract lines onto another service — Autotask can’t change a contract line’s service, so each move is two rows: (1) an adjustment adding the target service to the s… |
| `autotask_contract_plan_wording` | read-only | Build (nothing is written) a frozen plan that updates the INVOICE TEXT of existing contract lines (ContractServices and ContractServiceBundles invoiceDescription) to the catalog’s current wording. |
| `autotask_change_plan_revert` | read-only | Build (nothing is written) an UNDO plan for an executed change plan, from the before-images it kept: updated fields are put back (a field changed again since is skipped as stale); a service the plan created is deactiv… |
| `autotask_vendor_monitor` | read-only | One monitoring pass, each finding sent once as a notification (console → Notifications): a vendor with no invoice imported for 35+ days; subscriptions on the latest invoice renewing within 30 days (annual commitments … |
| `autotask_billing_preinvoice_check` | read-only | Run BEFORE Approve & Post. |
| `autotask_pricing_customer_notices` | writes | Customer notice for a contract pricing plan (default: the newest open one). |

| `autotask_search_companies` | writes | Search companies. Plain mode: searchTerm (name contains) + isActive (+ classification label or id, + companyType with classification), paged, max 200/page; each row carries classification as {id, label} or null. IDENT… |
| `autotask_get_company` | read-only | The complete company record by ID with creation metadata: every picklist labelled (company type, classification, territory, market segment, …), owner / created-by / impersonator resources and parent company named, UDFs with list labels. |
| `autotask_find_company_contact_candidates` | read-only | Given any of companyName, contactName, email, phone, domain, it searches contacts (exact email across all email fields, name, phone) and companies (normalized name, web domain, contacts' email domain, phone), links th… |
| `autotask_find_duplicate_companies` | read-only | Likely duplicates of ONE company (searched around it, not a tenant scan): same normalized name, web domain, phone, or company number — inactive companies and creation dates included, each with evidence and conflicts. |
| `autotask_merge_discover` | read-only | Find candidate duplicate companies / contacts before a merge: by email (exact, across ALL THREE contact email fields, active and inactive, every page — no 200 cap), by company name (exact), or around given companyIds … |
| `autotask_merge_dependency_inventory` | read-only | For each company id (and / or contact id): every record pointing at it, per entity — contacts, tickets, projects, contracts (active ones counted), opportunities, quotes, sales orders, configuration items, service call… |
| `autotask_merge_build_plan` | writes | Build a MERGE PLAN — addressed ONLY by numeric Autotask ids, one kind per plan. |
| `autotask_merge_verify` | read-only | After the UI merges: re-reads every survivor and source of a merge plan and everything that pointed at the sources. |
| `autotask_bulk_inactivate` | writes | Bulk cleanup of PLACEHOLDER companies (e.g. the tens of thousands named "Gmail") and their contacts — prepared from the Postgres mirror, pushed to Autotask by a background worker at a set pace, so no chat ever loops thousands of writes. |
| `autotask_create_company` | writes | Create new company record. |
